Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-17 steps 3, 5; TFA-92595 AC 3 · “re-tapping after an edit copies the latest edited text (confirm no real EHR read/write happens anywhere, clipboard only)”. Mixed: stated part — Edit, copy, edit again and re-copy gives the latest edit in both modes; copying contacts no EHR; our part — A draft surviving a toggle round-trip and a cancelled draft not being copied (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S02 Edit → copy → edit again → re-copy gives the latest edit; a draft survives a toggle round-trip; a cancelled draft is not copied; only local hosts are contacted while copying (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 After editing the note, 'Copy to EMR' copies the current edited text to the clipboard (a clipboard copy only). (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U5 Editing the note again and re-tapping 'Copy to EMR' copies the latest edited text. (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T2 Copy is clipboard only: no real EHR read or write happens anywhere. (TFA-92595 AC 3; TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U9 Both modes (ground rule 3.3): TC-17 does not say Hospital-only, so every outcome above must hold in Hospital and in Nursing Home. The ticket has no Hospital/Nursing Home AC (Q3). (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-17) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient in note-ready with note N-H; Nursing Home resident with note N-N (seeded with createRoundingPatient / createSnfResident); a browser context granted clipboard-read and clipboard-write

When Hospital Post-Round: add the line QA-EDIT-1, Save Edits, Copy, read the clipboard (a1); edit to QA-EDIT-2, go to tasks and back to note with the editor open (a2); Save Edits, Copy, read (a3); add QA-EDIT-3, Cancel, Copy, read (a4). Nursing Home: QA-EDIT-N1 → Save Edits → Copy → read (a5); …

Then Each copy holds the whole saved note with the latest saved marker and never the one it replaced; the open editor still holds QA-EDIT-2 after the toggle round-trip; after Cancel the clipboard holds QA-EDIT-2, not QA-EDIT-3; the Nursing Home copies behave the same and never carry the Hospital note; every origin contacted while copying is the local stack

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Scripted Playwright assertions, never an agent's snapshot: after each Copy, page.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText()) is asserted to contain the marker plus a sentence of the original note (the whole note, not a fragment) and not the replaced marker; a2 asserts the editor's value. a4 reads 'current edited text' as the saved note (Q6). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

How it is tested (newspec-c/plan.json, automatable: yes): New Playwright spec: fresh account, Hospital patient seeded note-ready with N-H, resident seeded with N-N (rounding:add / snf:add then update with note + noteGeneratedAt). Context granted clipboard-read/write. Post-Round: Edit Note, append marker, Save Edits, Copy to EMR, read navigator.clipboard (a1); edit to QA-EDIT-2, go to Tasks and back (a2 editor value); Save Edits, Copy, read (a3); add QA-EDIT-3, Cancel, Copy, read (a4); Nursing Home a5/a6. Every request / WebSocket URL from the first Copy to the last read is recorded and checked against the local allowlist (a7). Billing is answered at the socket (not under test) so no model call is made. A sentinel is written to the clipboard before every Copy and the notice must read 'Note copied to clipboard'. — Clipboard read-back and the request allowlist are both scriptable in Playwright; seeding the note needs only the account's own mutations.
